subject: Data erasure logistics & evidence delivery: TTL/Residency Q&A

From: security@arbiterbank.com
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 17:14:00 -0500
Subject: Initial evidence request: residency/TTL erasure proofs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SOC 2 evidence collection we need to validate Redwood's tenant deletion and residency/TTL controls for a scoped set of Arbiter test tenants. Can you provide the following by 2026-01-20?

1) A sample runbook or step-by-step export that shows the tenant erasure process end-to-end (trigger -> job -> confirmation). Prefer a runbook plus one sample export with timestamps.
2) Residency mapping for the test tenants (which geozone each tenant lived in, and any transient caches).
3) Example logs or a sanitized erase audit record for one tenant covering the last 90 days (timestamps and job ids only, PII redacted).
4) Confirmation of where backups/snapshots are retained and the TTL applied to them.

We understand some artifacts are sensitive; if necessary, provide redacted samples and we can sign an NDA for anything else. Also include expected lead times for a complete packet.

Thanks,
Alex Mendes
Security Engineer
Arbiter Bank - InfoSec

Attachments: none

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial evidence request: residency/TTL erasure proofs

Alex,

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver redacted artifacts and a runbook sample. Quick clarifications so we scope correctly:

- For (1) runbook: do you want the operational playbook (steps our ops team runs) or the automated job output (task IDs + confirmations)? We can include both but they are separate files.
- For (3) logs: do you need the full application-level erase log or the storage-layer deletion confirmation (we have both but storage confirmations contain snapshot hashes we typically redact)?
- Sample tenant: please confirm one tenant id to scope to (or we can pick a synthetic tenant we control to avoid cross-tenant data).

Proposed delivery: redacted runbook + automated job output + residency_map.csv + one sanitized audit export by 2026-01-16. If you need the backups retention manifest included, say so and we'll add the backup retention section.

I'll loop in Karthik for the runbook and audit extraction.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, Security Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

Jonas / Marissa — attaching a first-pass runbook and a sanitized audit CSV. Highlights:

- erasure_runbook_v1.pdf: step sequence for request intake -> validation -> background job -> post-job verification -> audit stamping. Contains playbook commands and expected job IDs. Sensitive commands redacted.
- residency_map.csv: maps tenant_id -> primary_region -> last_active_node -> cache_hints.
- erase-log-sample-20260110.png: screenshot of job dashboard showing job id and success status (redacted session IDs).

Notes / open items:
- Backups: backups are retained in cold storage for 30 days by default. We can produce a backup retention manifest but it contains internal snapshot identifiers; recommend providing a redacted manifest unless Arbiter signs an NDA.
- TTL exceptions: one tenant in test org had a TTL exception flagged in Nov 2025; we should flag that in the packet and explain exception approval flow.
- Timeline: if Alex agrees to the synthetic tenant approach, we can hand over the full redacted packet (runbook + residency_map + audit CSV + retention manifest redactions) by EOD 2026-01-16.

Please review attachments and confirm if I should remove any additional fields.

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
